product_metadata.title: DII Farmhouse Vintage Decorative Metal Pantry Spice Rack Organizer, 17Lx2.3Wx20H", 4 Tier Spice Rack - White
features: WALL MOUNTED SPACE SAVER - Measures 17"x2.25"x21" with 2" shelf depth and 5.25" between shelves. Made of antique and distressed looking chicken wire. Our spice jars are designed to fit these shelves.

PLACE IT IN A CONVENIENT SPACE - This organizer will fit inside your pantry door, cabinet, or hang on your kitchen wall. Easy to keep discrete if desired or display for part of your décor, in any room or on any wall.

NOT JUST FOR THE KITCHEN - These versatile racks makes small spaces functional, hang in the guest bathroom to hold small lotions, makeup, sprays, bath soaps, hand towels, scented bath bombs, and other beauty supplies to make guests feel welcomed.

BRING A NEW LOOK TO YOUR KITCHEN - Get the look you've seen in magazines or DIY TV while adding functionality to your home. Keep all your spices organized while adding a touch of rustic chic, vintage inspiration to your space.
ALSO AVAILABLE . . . Not only do we have a 4 tier spice rack but we also have a 2 tier version to mix and match depending on your needs and space. Spices, Jars, and hardware are NOT included.
description: Crafted of antiqued finish “chicken coop” metal wire with a sturdy frame and vintage look, add country appeal to your kitchen with these charming spice racks. This 4 tier wire rack is perfect for wall mounting, cabinet, or pantry storage. Suitable for all your small organizing needs in the kitchen - from spices to oils, shot glasses, foods and jars. Or for your beauty needs, hang in the salon or bathroom to display or store your favorite nail polish, lotion, or essential oils!
